prompt: Listen and choose the best response.
promptZh: 請聽錄音，選出最適當的回應。
spokenPrompt: Who will show the new operator how to change the blade?
spokenPromptZh: 誰會教新操作員怎麼換刀片？

options.text: The blades come in packs of ten.
Jon will meet her at the cutter.
options.zh: 喬恩會到切割機旁和她碰面。

options.text: We changed it just before lunch.
options.whyZh: 回答舊作業何時做，沒有指派教學的人。

evidence: Who will show the new operator how to change the blade? / Jon will meet her at the cutter.

vocabulary.note: 說明設備操作時，change the blade 通常指換上另一片刀片。
